thread.title: Rep Ryan Zinke highlights support for Montana agriculture and constituent engagement

author: t. g. stallings
title: Rep Ryan Zinke highlights support for Montana agriculture and constituent engagement
text:
Rep. Ryan Zinke, U.S. Congressman representing Montana’s 1st district, posted a series of messages on social media expressing support for Montana agriculture and inviting constituents to connect with their congressional delegation during visits to Washington, D.C.
On March 24, 2026, Zinke wrote: “The @WhiteHouse is 100% behind Montana beef. American First means American Beef First! It’s time for mandatory country of origin labeling. https://t.co/urDWmATkU8”
Later that day, he acknowledged National Ag Day by stating: “Happy National Ag Day to the men and women who feed this country. Montana farmers and ranchers wake up early and don’t stop until the job is done, and my duty here in D.C. is to make sure they are supported along the way. I’m is fighting to keep our farmland out of foreign hands https://t.co/qBh0ueUp9v”
On March 25, Zinke encouraged Montanans visiting Washington during cherry blossom season to engage with their elected officials: “Great start to the day at Montana Coffee. If you are from Montana and coming to D.C. to see the Cherry Blossoms, make sure to schedule time to visit all four members of your congressional delegation every Wednesday morning when Congress is in session. Contact my office for https://t.co/5hbiGzMvHN”
Zinke has served as the representative for Montana’s 1st District since 2023 after replacing Steve Daines in Congress. He previously held office in the Montana Senate from 2009 to 2013 and was born in Bozeman in 1961 before settling in Whitefish. Zinke holds degrees from both the University of Oregon and National University.
